title: bot.ability.hearing.voice.identification.output
description: Voice embeddings identified from segmented voice audio.

id.description: The requester's id, echoed when the answer is the long-lived stage's reply to a request [floppy field].
id.title: Id

items.description: One voice segment: a reference to its clipped PCM with its format and span [floppy field].

audio.description: Reference (a URI reference) to the audio this stimulus carries; floppy passes media by reference, never as bytes [floppy field].
audio.title: Audio

media_type.description: Optional media type or codec label, such as audio/pcm or audio/opus.
media_type.title: Media Type

sample_rate_hz.description: Optional sample rate for raw or decoded audio, measured in hertz.
sample_rate_hz.title: Sample Rate Hz

channels.description: Optional number of audio channels represented by the chunk.
channels.title: Channels

start_seconds.description: Start of the segment, in seconds from the start of the utterance.
start_seconds.title: Start Seconds

end_seconds.description: End of the segment, in seconds from the start of the utterance.
end_seconds.title: End Seconds

confidence.description: Optional provider confidence for this segment, from 0 to 1.
confidence.title: Confidence

items.title: VoiceSegment

embeddings.description: Voice embeddings identified for the input voice segments, in input order. Empty means none, and an opening voice is then heard unidentified (decision D177).

items.description: Provider-neutral embedding value returned for an identified voice segment.

embedding.description: Provider-neutral numeric voice embedding produced by the classifier. Providers decide how to index and compare the vector; it is not a human-readable speaker label.
embedding.title: Embedding

model.description: Optional embedding model identifier that produced this voice embedding.
model.title: Model

confidence.description: Optional provider confidence that the voice embedding represents this speaker, normalized from 0.0 to 1.0.
confidence.title: Confidence

items.title: VoiceEmbedding

embeddings.title: Embeddings
